title: Native engine manifests and cues
acceptance: Every engine the catalog lists has a manifest stating only what the engine honours: its parameters with bounds, and which it changes while it runs (cueable); unit-tested against the catalog.

A scene's params are validated against its engine's manifest with a path and a code; a beat's cue is one of the running scene's named cues or set:<parameter>=<value> on a cueable parameter, refused otherwise with the engine's offer; unit-tested.
A scene lowers to the score as a field cue (the theme's defaults under its params; the Living Flame a whole recipe from preset and macros) or a procedural cue the gallery field admits; unit-tested.

A cue reaches the running engine when its beat begins, as the manifest's commands through the existing visual-control path, validated against the active engine's manifest; the attractor's intensity and the flame's macros change in place; unit-tested at the conductor, the runtime, the contract and the director.
The Worker's schema admits params and the guide lists every engine with its parameters and cues; the catalog marks every listed engine composer-ready.

evidence.note: The Creative Control design; §9 native engines and manifests.

Manifests for every catalog engine (src/scenes/manifests.js), params and cue validation, cues through the visual-control path; the Living Flame joins the composer. Unit evidence: src/scenes/manifests.test.js, src/core/beats.test.js, src/live/beat-conductor.test.js, src/live/runtime.v2.test.js, src/visuals/attractor-manifest.test.js, src/live/host/stage-controls.test.js, src/live/host/controls.test.js, src/components/read/Chamber.beat-typography.test.js, Chamber.beat-place.test.js, Chamber.beat-size.test.js. Browser evidence: the full-validation run linked from the PR.

activity.summary: Opened after CC-003; built directly against the design. Living Flame joins the composer (widens RDR-023 at the owner's direction).
Two card defects fixed after the first validation run (Intensity only for a cueable field; the voice waits for the reading through a hold); beat size step and text controls fixed; PR evidence linked

summary: Every native engine exposed to the model with truthful parameter manifests; scene params and cues validated against them; cues delivered to the running engine through the existing visual-control path.
